description: Task 12.15 — the one capability granting the main window IPC access to Tauri's own core defaults (window/app/event plumbing the WebView needs regardless of which app command it calls) plus every meridian-desktop command build.rs autogenerated an allow-<command> permission for (see that file's own doc comment). Scoped to the single `main` window this task creates (tauri.conf.json's `app.windows`) — no other window/webview label exists yet for this capability to also need to cover.
